Types of no deposit bonuses

When choosing a no deposit bonus, online casino offers will likely come in a few different forms. In Canada, free spins and bonus credits are still the most common casino offers. There will be specific features that vary between casinos and bonus types. Some no deposit bonuses are tied to specific slots, some are built exclusively for mobile play, and a few return a percentage of any losses you incur as cashback. Below, we break down the different no deposit bonus types you’re most likely to see at Canadian online casinos.

Free spins
Get a set number of free spins on specific slots (or a selection). Wins are yours to keep but usually come with wagering requirements.
Learn more
Game-specific bonuses
Use a game-specific bonus to try new slots or tables. Casinos may give you credit to play roulette, blackjack, or even bingo. Wagering requirements apply.
Learn more
Cashback bonuses
On rare occasions, casinos will give you a percentage of your losses back (up to a limit) on some no deposit offers.
Learn more

What is a casino no deposit bonus?

A casino no deposit bonus is a special offer that gives you bonus funds or free spins simply for registering with a Canadian online casino. You don’t need to make a deposit to qualify, making them a risk-free way to test out games and explore a new platform.

Here are the key things to know:

✅ No deposit required – Just sign up and the bonus is yours.
🎰 Smaller than welcome bonuses – Usually less generous, but you can still win real money.
🔑 Wagering terms apply – You’ll need to bet the bonus amount a set number of times before withdrawing.
💳 Deposit may be needed later – In many cases, you must make a deposit to unlock or cash out winnings.

To see what’s possible, check out our top-rated real money online casinos offering trusted no deposit rewards.

Ready to see today’s bonuses? Jump to the latest offers.
How we review no deposit bonus casinos

We don’t just look at the size of the bonus. To recommend a no deposit casino, our team puts each site through a multi-step review focused on how well the offer works in practice. Here’s how we test every no deposit bonus casino before adding it to our list of trusted Canadian casinos.

Bonus size

When it comes to no deposit deals, size matters. Some bonuses are just a few dollars, while others go as high as $50 or more. We check if the amount is playable and worth your time.

💡 Expert tip: The real value of any no deposit deal is in the terms and conditions. If the rules are too restrictive, the bonus may not be worth much. On the bright side, if you do not win, there is nothing to lose.

Eligible games

Some casinos limit no deposit bonuses to one or two slot titles, while others let you explore a bigger selection of games. We always test which titles are included and whether table games or live dealer options are also eligible.

💡 Expert tip: Cash bonuses and coins from sweepstakes casinos can usually be used on more games than free spins, which are often locked to a single slot.

Withdrawal process

We test how easy it is to turn a no deposit bonus into real money. That includes meeting the wagering requirements, checking how long payouts take, and confirming which withdrawal methods are supported.

💡 Expert tip: Speed varies by method. E-wallets and crypto withdrawals tend to be fastest, but some casinos have slower processing times even after you have met the terms.

App-only rewards

We test bonuses across desktop a
[...]
cash that can be used to try out games.

While you can win real money using a no deposit bonus, you’ll usually need to meet certain wagering requirements before withdrawing any winnings. This means playing through the bonus amount a set number of times first.

Do I need to register to play no deposit games?

Usually, but not always! While you can typically play your favourite slots and table games without signing up, you'll almost always need to register an account to be eligible to receive the no deposit bonus.

Can I play no deposit games on my mobile or tablet?

Usually, yes. Most no deposit bonuses work on mobile browsers and tablets, but some are limited to certain games, bonus types, or app downloads. Check the terms before you claim, especially if a casino is promoting a mobile-only reward.

Can I withdraw real money from a no deposit bonus?

Yes, but only if you meet the bonus terms. Most no deposit offers come with higher wagering requirements, often between 35x and 200x, and many casinos cap how much you can cash out from those winnings, often around $20 and usually under $50. You will almost always need to verify your ID, and some casinos also ask for a small qualifying deposit before they approve a withdrawal.

Can I claim more than one no deposit bonus?

You can normally only claim one no deposit bonus per casino, and creating multiple accounts to get extra bonuses will almost always see your offers and winnings cancelled. You can, however, claim separate no deposit bonuses at different casinos, as long as you follow each site’s terms and conditions.
